payload.description:
## Trigger

When someone runs claim on a record that is already closed, I want the claim refused by name with the reopen command, so I can never move finished work back to in progress by mistake.

## Context

2026-09-25: python3 .basicly/core/kit/tracker/cli.py claim .basicly/ledger basicly-zem45s8 on the closed record appended an assignee event and a status in_progress event, with no refusal. The record read in_progress until it was closed again.
payload.requirements: A claim never changes the status of a closed record.
